why: The figures fill places one by one: down the first column, then the second column. In each step the line moves one place forward and a square takes its old place. A: line in place 1; B: square, line; so C: square, square, line. That is option 1. Option 4 has the line in the wrong position (too far right), and option 5 has a flat line instead of a standing line.
trick: Think of the boxes as numbered places and watch how the newest item moves forward one place each step.
